C26 computes per-cell hazen p90 thresholds from the C19 pools, which cover every SST value from 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05. It smooths them with a cumulative-sum moving mean whose prefix sums take in every raw day-of-year threshold, so the edge days 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 also reach the mask. It then compares all 92 target days for every sea cell and runs the hot-run/merge logic."}
